stages.J1.otp: Login OTP/verification code not received, late, or expired
stages.J1.session: Logged out repeatedly, forced to log in/OTP every time, SSO re-login, falls back to a web login page
stages.J1.other: Other onboarding: registration, company access/subscription denied, profile or home address set-up
stages.J2: Roster & shift: shift schedule, roster not updated, shift times wrong
stages.J3.fail: Self-booking fails: error, stuck, booking not saved or not going through, booked trip disappears, no trips available to book
stages.J3.window: Self-booking blocked by rules: booking window closed, cut-off time, must book days ahead, not allowed to cancel late
stages.J3.steps: Self-booking effort: too many steps, confusing booking flow, unclear whether booking succeeded, must book repeatedly
stages.J3.modify: Changing a booking: cancel, reschedule, change pickup address/time for a trip
stages.J3.other: Other booking problem not covered above
stages.J4.route: Routing & pooling: wrong or long route, detours, illogical pickup order, unrelated co-passengers clubbed
stages.J4.time: Pickup time: too early, long total travel time, pickup time keeps changing
stages.J4.alloc: Allocation: cab not assigned, assigned too late, no cab available
stages.J5.missing: Notifications missing/late/wrong: pickup time or cab details not shared, wrong 'not booked' alerts
stages.J5.noise: Too many or irrelevant notifications and alerts
stages.J6: Live tracking & trip visibility: GPS lag, vehicle location wrong, ETA wrong, map not updating, can't see co-passengers/sequence
stages.J7.late: Cab late, did not wait, or never came
stages.J7.board: Boarding: OTP/QR at pickup, check-in, driver verification problems
stages.J7.noshow: Wrongly marked as no-show/absent, or penalised (e.g. return trip auto-cancelled) after a no-show
stages.J7.contact: Cannot contact the driver: in-app call fails, no chat option, driver unreachable
stages.J8.driver: Driver behaviour: rude, unprofessional, rash driving, does not follow route
stages.J8.vehicle: Vehicle: condition, AC, cleanliness, wrong vehicle type
stages.J8.drop: Drop: wrong drop point, dropped far from home, drop delays
stages.J9: Issue reporting & resolution: helpdesk unreachable, complaints ignored, no status on raised requests, rude transport team
stages.X1.crash: Stability: crashes, freezes, won't open, stuck loading, broken after update, device incompatibility
stages.X1.slow: Performance: slow loading, lag, heavy app, battery or data drain
stages.X2.design: UI/UX: confusing interface, redesign made it worse, hard to find features, too many screens
stages.X2.interrupt: Interruptions: terms to accept on every open, launch banners/pop-ups, forced trip rating or feedback before access, repeated rating requests
stages.X3: Workplace features: desk booking, meeting rooms, office attendance, parking
stages.P: Praise or general positive with no specific problem
stages.U: Unclear, irrelevant, or too vague to place (e.g. 'worst app' with nothing else)

attribution.app: The app itself is at fault (bug, crash, design, missing feature, tracking accuracy)
attribution.ops: The transport service is at fault (cab late, driver, vehicle, routing decisions by the ops team)
attribution.policy: A rule set by the employer is the cause (cut-off times, booking windows, eligibility, roster rules)
attribution.mixed: Clearly more than one of app / ops / policy

sentiment.mixed: Text has both clear praise and clear complaint

label_line.i: integer — the review's local id in the chunk
label_line.st: list of 1-3 stage codes, most important first
label_line.d: string, <= 8 words — the specific issue in plain words
label_line.se: sentiment of the TEXT ONLY, ignoring the star rating
label_line.sf: boolean — true if the review describes a personal-safety risk
